vo.l01: Tonight... a man punches a cactus. What could possibly go wrong here?
vo.l02: In the red corner... the human! Has never kept a single houseplant alive, read zero instructions, and thinks boxing gloves make him totally invincible.
vo.l03: And in the blue corner... the cactus! Four thousand spines, drinks water once a month, has never lost a hug, and has never once moved out of the way.
vo.l04: Fun fact: a cactus can live two hundred years. This human might not survive two rounds.
vo.l05: Ohh! The human lands a big right hand... directly into the spines!
vo.l06: But the cactus has something humans never had... pure pointy defense.
vo.l08: Down goes the human! He hugged the cactus!
vo.l11: The human is fine, folks. He just needs some tweezers, a long weekend, and maybe a nice plastic plant next time.
vo.l12: Let's see that again... every single punch he throws, the cactus just stands there and lets him hurt himself.

caption: Never punch a cactus 🌵🥊 Who did you think would win? 👇
